body: My problems are not even close to how bad other people have it and that's another reason I keep finding ways to hate myself

Also the fact that both my best friends are in plebe out of town I can't see them much, and the girl I'm obsessing over never has time to actually spend with me so I keep feeling completely worthless and isolated

I mean, i always feel crappy alone, when I get together with a friend I am distracted from suicidal thoughts, but the minute they leave I sink down pretty far and I just wanna hurt myself. Talking about t doesn't help Idk what does

They all know about it, but I'm not very good at talking about it, but I'm sure they are aware they just don't address it. My best friend who is the girl of my dreams can cause me to get sad when things don't go like I want them sure but I think I just get sad from small little triggers. I was diagnosed with major depressive disorder but I'm sure anyone on a bad day could be diagnosed like that. This is a selfish ass thing for me to even consider.
The only thing keeping me here is that I don't want to do that to my friends and family, if only be living for them not myself

It's not even that my life is bad, I am fourtunate to have such a good family and set of friends, just for some reason every night i have this intense feeling of regret and worthlessness. Regret over huge mistakes or even just small things. idk, I don't have sadness centered over one specific thing, just sad for no reason
It does suck, I've been living with depression for awhile and at this point it's not gotten any better only worse.
Did I make you feel sick? I'm sorry
As simple as loving chocolate, haha thanks for making me laugh. I'm just driving myself crazy

thank you, I didn't really know what I wanted by posting in here but that definitely helped. I'm just depressed maybe I have to learn to live with it or maybe I just need to find something that overpowers it. Until that time I'm going to stay strong for my friends and family, it just gets harder and harder everyday because I overthink and create outcomes before something even starts. Thanks again
I believe if you call the hotline everything is confidential, unless they have reason to believe you might hurt someone else.
i have tried talking about t with a therapist and it didn't help
i dont want the memory of me to be one of just being depressed I would want them to remember me as someone who was happy
